usage_boundary: Development verification only. These fixtures may establish DEV_COMPLETE. They must never be presented as final evidence, and no measurement claimed from them is a final POC benchmark result.

dataset.name: ARKitScenes
dataset.license_note: Apple ARKitScenes is released for research use under the terms stated in the upstream repository. Fixtures are consumed unmodified.

fixtures.selection_rationale: Selected first and retained under the discovery stop rule: all core modalities decode, the 60 s handheld trajectory spans 7.28 x 3.00 x 4.10 m of room-scale structure, and metadata.csv marks has_laser_scanner_point_clouds=True so an independent non-ARKit reference exists for this exact visit.
fixtures.tuning_permission: This is the only scene on which the single predetermined geometry sweep permitted by the plan may be run.

fixtures.selection_rationale: Chosen by a predetermined deterministic rule rather than by inspection: the lowest video_id in raw/metadata.csv with fold=Training, has_laser_scanner_point_clouds=True, is_in_threedod=True, and a visit_id different from the primary. No scene was previewed, compared, or swapped for a better-looking result.
fixtures.tuning_permission: NO_TUNING. This scene is run once with the frozen configuration produced on PRIMARY_TUNING. It must never influence a parameter value.
